6-236-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-236-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-236-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

4381-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
4381-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-5658-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-413-5929.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-413-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-5424-6751.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve both Sailor of Means triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2921-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4772-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4772-5526-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4050-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4050-5870.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2558-2981-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2981-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-4772-5742-5743.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

413-1887-3305-4022-5926.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Grist trigger, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once, while the Grist, Voracious Larva token and Blasting Station each trigger for each token created this way
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

328-1409-2060-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Crystalline Crawler.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
328-1409-2060-4017.description:
Activate Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Resolve the Gray Merchant of Asphodel trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting at least two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black is at least three, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and infinite mana.

2226-2397-4576.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2226-2397-4576.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-4576.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by paying {1}{G}{W}.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may use that mana to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by paying its mana cost.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1428-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rekindling Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Rekindling Phoenix dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Rekindling Phoenix trigger, creating a 0/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Rekindling Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

4499-5168-5291.description:
Cast Cursor Mirror by paying {2}{R}.
Choose to have Cursed Mirror enter the battlefield as a copy of Bloom Tender with haste.
Activate Cursed Mirror by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{W}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Cursed Mirror.
Repeat from step 2.

776-1306-1329-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1306-1329-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Mana Crypt to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Mana Crypt.
Cast Mana Crypt.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

864-2334-4872.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
